content.text: Abhi Raj ji, aapki health Oct 2027 mein theek hogi jab Venus-Saturn-Jupiter period mein aayega, kyunki aapka 1st cusp sub-lord Jupiter houses 1,4,8,9 signify karta hai jo recovery ke liye positive hai. Jupiter ka strong influence aapki vitality aur healing power ko badhaega at age 22.

Divya Singh ji, your government job opportunity will come in Dec 2026 to Jan 2027 when you are 31 years old, during Mercury-Sun period. Your 10th cusp sub-lord Ketu signifies house 4 which connects to public service, and Sun's strong signification of houses 2,3,9,11 during its antardasha brings government authority and career elevation. The combination of Mercury mahadasha (communication/administration) with Sun antardasha (government/authority) creates the perfect timing for securing a government position.

Priya ji, aapka business Jul 2027 mein start karna chahiye jab Venus-Saturn-Ketu period chalega, kyunki aapka 7th cusp sub-lord Venus houses 4,5,10,11,12 signify karta hai jo partnership aur gains ke liye favorable hai. Is time aapki age 23 years hogi aur Saturn ka influence business establishment mein stability dega.

Anurag Singh ji, in 2020 you likely experienced significant mental growth and educational developments during Moon-Mercury antardasha from Feb 2020 to Jul 2021, when you were around 13 years old. Mercury as the sub-lord of your 1st cusp signifies houses 1,7,8,10,12, bringing transformative learning experiences and possibly changes in your educational path or communication skills during this formative period.

Siddharth ji, your first child will arrive in May 2032 to Apr 2033 during Mars-Jupiter period when you are 40-41 years old, as your 5th cusp sub-lord Sun signifies houses 3,7,10,11,12 and Jupiter as antardasha lord brings blessings by signifying houses 2,4,7,9,11 including the vital 2nd house for family expansion. The combination of Mars mahadasha (signifying houses 3,7,9,10,11,12) with Jupiter antardasha creates the perfect timing for childbirth as both planets activate the 11th house of fulfillment along with the 2nd house of family growth.

Abhi Raj ji, I understand you're facing challenging times and my heart goes out to you during this difficult period. Currently you're in Venus-Saturn period until Mar 2028, and Saturn as your 7th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 1,2,3,4,7,9 which can bring responsibilities and lessons that feel heavy but ultimately lead to growth and maturity. This phase is teaching you resilience and preparing you for the beautiful Venus-Mercury period starting Mar 2028 when things will significantly lighten up.

Priyanka ji, your strongest marriage window is Nov 2030 to Feb 2031 during Rahu-Venus period, when Jupiter as sub-lord of 7th cusp activates houses 7,9,10,12 making marriage highly favorable at age 36. Venus as antardasha lord signifies houses 2,7,11 which are all marriage-positive, creating the perfect combination for matrimony.

Ananya ji, you will achieve good financial stability as your 2nd cusp sub-lord Ketu signifies houses 2, 3, 4 which support wealth accumulation and property gains. Your current Mercury-Venus period until Dec 2028 is particularly favorable since both Mercury and Venus are strong significators of houses 2, 6, 7, 11 bringing income through partnerships and service. The combination of your 11th cusp sub-lord Sun with houses 2, 10, 12 indicates gains through authority positions, though some expenses on family will continue.

Vikrant Kumar ji, you have strong wealth potential as your 2nd cusp sub-lord Saturn signifies houses 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8 which includes both wealth (2nd) and sudden gains (8th) houses. Your current Jupiter-Saturn period until May 2028 is particularly favorable since Jupiter signifies houses 3, 4, 6, 9 and Saturn brings the 2nd house connection for accumulating wealth. The combination of 8th house signification suggests potential for inheritance or unexpected financial gains, while Saturn's methodical nature indicates wealth will build steadily through disciplined effort and long-term investments.
Rajesh ji, aapki rashi Libra hai jo Venus ke dwara govern hoti hai.

Priya ji, to strengthen Sun in your chart and improve career recognition, wearing a 1 Mukhi Rudraksha is recommended. It enhances leadership qualities and brings government opportunities since your 10th cusp sub-lord Ketu signifies houses 2,5,8,11. You can find it at Japam store.

Sanjay Kumar ji, your best career path is in government service or authority-based roles since your 10th cusp sub-lord Jupiter signifies houses 8 and 11, while Sun strongly signifies houses 5, 7, 10, 11, and 12 with particular strength in the 10th house of career. Your combination of Sun's government connection and Jupiter's wisdom influence suggests administrative roles, public sector banking, or educational institutions under government aegis would bring you maximum success and recognition. The strong 11th house signification from both planets ensures good income and fulfillment of professional ambitions in these fields.

Aditya ji, I understand your struggles feel overwhelming right now, and it's natural to seek answers during challenging times. Your current Jupiter-Mars period until Dec 2026 shows Mars as your 7th cusp sub-lord Ketu signifying house 12, which can bring hidden obstacles and emotional turbulence. However, your upcoming Jupiter-Rahu period from Dec 2026 will bring significant relief as Rahu signifies house 6 which helps overcome enemies and obstacles, marking a turning point in your life at age 31.

Divya Singh ji, you have excellent wealth potential as your 2nd cusp sub-lord Venus signifies houses 6, 7, 10, 11, 12 which includes the crucial 11th house of gains and 10th house of career success. Your current Mercury-Venus period until Aug 2026 is particularly favorable for financial growth since both Mercury and Venus are strong wealth significators connecting houses 2, 7, 10, 11. The combination of Venus (luxury, arts) with Mercury (business, communication) suggests wealth through creative ventures, partnerships, or communication-based businesses, and this wealth-building phase will continue strongly through your Mercury mahadasha until May 2037 when you'll be 41.

Priya Raj ji, aapka career bahut accha rahega kyunki aapki 10th cusp sub-lord Moon signifies houses 1,3,10,12 jo career growth ke liye positive hai. Venus-Saturn period mein (current till Dec 2028) aapko government sector ya public dealing wala kaam milega kyunki Sun aapke 10th house ko signify karta hai. Sun mahadasha Dec 2032 se start hogi tab aap 27 saal ki hongi aur government job ya leadership position confirm hai kyunki Sun houses 2,5,7,8,10 signify karta hai.

Priya ji, your foreign travel will materialize in Sep 2026 to Jan 2027 when you'll be 34, during Jupiter-Rahu period as your 12th cusp sub-lord Mercury signifies houses 4,7,8,9,12 which strongly support foreign journeys. The combination of Jupiter's expansion with Rahu's foreign influence creates the ideal timing for overseas opportunities.

Priya ji, in 2022 you were running Venus-Rahu antardasha from Feb 2020 to Feb 2023. This period brought expansion and material gains as your antardasha lord Rahu signifies houses 3,9,10,12 which includes career growth and foreign connections.

Sushant ji, your chart strongly indicates a career in communication, technology, or business fields since your 10th cusp sub-lord Venus signifies houses 2, 8, 9 which brings wealth through transformation and higher knowledge. Mercury as the sole significator of the 10th house confirms careers in IT, writing, media, or commerce, while Venus adds creative and luxury-related dimensions. Your current Rahu-Saturn period until Oct 2026 may bring some delays, but the upcoming Rahu-Mercury period from Oct 2026 to Apr 2029 will activate your career potential significantly when you'll be 20-22 years old.

Anurag ji, aapke paas paisa Apr 2027 mein aayega jab Mars-Saturn-Venus period chalega, kyunki aapka 2nd cusp sub-lord Venus houses 2,5,9 signify karta hai jo wealth ke liye positive hai. Aap tab 20 saal ke honge aur ye period aapko financial stability dega.

Rahul Singh ji, your chart strongly indicates a career in communication, technology, or analytical fields since your 10th cusp sub-lord Mars signifies houses 1, 3, 8, and 12, with Mercury being the strongest career significator through houses 1, 3, 8, 10, and 12. The combination of Mercury's influence on your 10th house along with Mars energy suggests engineering, IT consulting, research, or technical writing would be most suitable. Your Venus mahadasha period (current until Dec 2040) further supports creative or luxury-oriented professions, while the strong 3rd house connection indicates success in media, communication, or travel-related work.

Sanjay Kumar ji, I understand that life feels overwhelming right now, and your feelings are completely valid. Your current Moon-Venus period until Jul 2026 shows Venus signifying houses 1,6,8 which can bring challenges related to health, debts, and personal struggles, while your 1st cusp sub-lord Mars creates some internal conflicts. However, your upcoming Moon-Sun period from Jul 2026 will bring significant relief as Sun strongly signifies houses 5,7,10,11 indicating better career prospects, relationships, and overall life satisfaction at age 40.

Deepika ji, aapka videsh jaana Nov 2026 mein hoga jab Venus-Moon-Rahu period chalega, kyunki aapka 12th cusp sub-lord Ketu houses 1,3,7,8,11 signify karta hai jo foreign travel ke liye favorable hai. Aap us time 32 saal ki hongi aur yeh travel career ya personal reasons se ho sakta hai.

Sneha ji, aapka videsh jaana Apr 2027 mein hoga jab Rahu-Venus-Rahu period chalega, kyunki aapki 12th cusp sub-lord Mars signifies houses 1,10 jo foreign travel ke liye favorable hai. Rahu aur Venus dono foreign connections dete hain aur aapki age 33-34 years mein yeh opportunity aayegi.

Aadhya ji, aapki tension samajh mein aati hai, yeh Moon-Rahu-Saturn pratyantar dasha ka asar hai jo emotional stress laata hai. Aapka Moon 6th house signify karta hai jo anxiety aur tension ka karak hai, lekin yeh phase Mar 2026 mein khatam ho jayega aur Apr 2026 se Moon-Rahu-Mercury shuru hoga jo mental peace dega.

Maya Reddy ji, your first child will come in Mar 2027 to Jun 2027 during Ketu-Mars period when you'll be 33 years old, as your 5th cusp sub-lord Mars signifies houses 3,5,6,8,9,10 which includes the 5th house of children. The combination of Mars (energy for childbirth) with houses 5 (children) and 9 (fortune) creates favorable conditions for conception and delivery.

Rahul Singh ji, aapki health generally strong rahegi kyunki aapka 1st cusp sub-lord Ketu houses 1,3,12 signify karta hai jo vitality maintain karta hai. Current Venus-Moon period mein Moon ka 6th house connection minor digestive ya emotional stress la sakta hai, lekin yeh temporary hai. Venus-Mars period (Dec 2026 to Feb 2028) mein extra care leni hogi kyunki Mars 1st aur 8th house signify karta hai jo energy fluctuations de sakta hai.

Rohan ji, samay ke saath sab kuch badal jaata hai aur aapka bhi waqt zaroor aayega. Aapke 1st cusp sub-lord Venus jo houses 1,6,9,11,12 signify karta hai, ye dikhata hai ki aap challenges overcome kar sakte hain aur gains pa sakte hain. Mercury mahadasha mein jo Dec 2040 tak chalega, aapko communication aur business mein opportunities milenge kyunki Mercury houses 1,7,8,10 signify karta hai.

Nikhil Kumar ji, aapki shaadi Nov 2026 se Mar 2027 ke beech hogi jab Jupiter-Rahu-Venus period chalega, kyunki aapke 7th cusp sub-lord Venus signify karta hai houses 5,7,10,11 jo marriage ke liye bahut positive hai. Aap us time 37 saal ke honge aur Venus ka influence romantic aur beautiful spouse dega.

Anurag Singh ji, you are currently running Mars-Jupiter-Ketu period until Mar 2026, which is highly favorable for your spiritual growth and education since Mars signifies houses 3,5,6,8,10 while Jupiter signifies houses 1,2,4,6,7,8,10,12 and Ketu signifies houses 2,9,11. This combination brings opportunities in higher learning, research, and gaining wisdom through unconventional means. From Mar 2026, you will enter Mars-Jupiter-Venus period until May 2026 which will be excellent for creative pursuits, relationships, and financial gains as Venus signifies houses 2,5,9 bringing prosperity and harmony. At age 18-19, this is a transformative phase where your educational foundation and personal values are being strongly established.

Sudhir Singh ji, your move to your current city likely occurred during Jupiter-Saturn antardasha from Jan 2022 to Aug 2024, when you were around 33-35 — Saturn as the sub-lord of your 4th cusp signifies houses 4,6,7,8,9,11 which includes residence changes and new settlements. The 4th house connection through Saturn indicates this relocation brought stability to your home environment.

Palak ji, your marriage will come at age 22-23 in Jul 2027 to Nov 2027 during Venus-Saturn period, as your 7th cusp sub-lord Moon signifies houses 1,3,10,12 and gets activated by Saturn who signifies marriage house 7. This timing aligns when Moon's emotional connections combine with Saturn's commitment energy to bring matrimonial opportunities.

Arjun ji, your marriage will happen in Aug 2027 to Feb 2028 when you are 41, during Venus-Mercury-Jupiter period. Your 7th cusp sub-lord Venus signifies houses 1,8,10,12 which shows some delays, but Jupiter's influence in the pratyantar activates houses 3,5,6 creating the marriage combination through its connection to significators Mars and Sun who represent houses 2,7,11.

Arjun ji, aap haar nahin gaye hain - yeh sirf ek mushkil daur hai jo guzar jayega. Aapka 1st cusp sub-lord Saturn houses 3,5,6,8,12 signify karta hai jo challenges laata hai lekin aapka strong Sun in 5th house courage aur leadership deta hai. Current Rahu-Mercury-Saturn period Mar 2026 tak challenging hai par Jul 2026 se Rahu-Ketu period mein aapki inner strength aur spiritual growth hogi.

Sudhir Singh ji, your relocation to your current city likely happened during Jupiter-Saturn antardasha from Jan 2022 to Aug 2024, when you were around 33-35 years old — Saturn as the 4th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 4,6,7,8,9,11 which includes 4th house of residence and change of place. The Saturn antardasha period would have brought significant changes in your living situation and home base.

Nikhil Kumar ji, to strengthen your marriage prospects, wearing an 11 Mukhi Rudraksha is recommended as it enhances Moon's positive influence on your 7th house of marriage and brings emotional harmony in relationships. Your 7th cusp sub-lord Venus signifies houses 5,7,10,11 which are marriage-positive, but Moon's strength will help manifest this during Jupiter-Rahu period. You can find it at Japam store.

Anurag ji, aapki shaadi Mar 2029 mein hogi jab aap 22 saal ke honge, Mars-Venus antardasha mein. Aapka 7th cusp sub-lord Jupiter houses 1,2,4,6,7,8,10,12 signify karta hai jo marriage ke liye positive hai kyunki 2 aur 7 dono included hain. Venus antardasha mein marriage planet Venus activate hoga aur Jupiter ki blessings se arranged marriage hogi.

Varun ji, to strengthen your marriage prospects, wearing a 2 Mukhi Rudraksha is recommended as it harmonizes relationships and removes obstacles in finding the right partner. Your 7th cusp sub-lord Sun signifies houses 4,7,10,11,12 which shows marriage potential, and this remedy will enhance the positive significations while reducing delays. You can find it at Japam store.

Rohan ji, in March 2018 you were running Saturn-Rahu antardasha which was active from July 2018 to May 2021. This period brought significant karmic lessons and material ambitions since Saturn as your 2nd and 3rd cusp sub-lord combined with Rahu signifying houses 2,5,11,12 created a mix of financial growth and unexpected changes at age 28.

Harsh ji, aapki shaadi Jupiter-Venus antardasha mein hui hogi May 2020 to Feb 2022 ke beech, jab aap 30-32 saal ke the. Jupiter aur Venus dono 7th house (marriage) ke significator hain aur Venus as 7th cusp sub-lord marriage ke liye bahut favorable period tha.

Anuj ji, your health challenges may primarily involve digestive issues and mental stress since your 1st cusp sub-lord Sun signifies houses 1,2,4,5,6 including the 6th house of illness. The 6th cusp sub-lord Saturn in Taurus indicates chronic digestive problems or issues related to throat and neck area, as Saturn brings long-term health concerns. You should be particularly careful during Mercury-Saturn period from Sep 2032 to May 2035 when you'll be 29-32 years old, as both planets connect to the 6th house and Saturn rules chronic conditions.

Aadhya ji, aapki shaadi Jul 2026 mein hogi jab Moon-Rahu-Venus period mein Venus activate hoga, kyunki aapka 7th cusp sub-lord Sun houses 2,7,9,10,11 signify karta hai jo marriage ke liye positive hai. Us time aapki age 30 saal hogi aur Venus being 4th lord family involvement bhi dikhata hai arranged marriage mein.

Amit Kumar ji, aapko paisa Oct 2027 mein milega jab Saturn-Mars antardasha shuru hogi, kyunki aapka 2nd cusp sub-lord Jupiter houses 6,10,12 signify karta hai jo income aur gains laata hai. Tab aap 37 saal ke honge aur Mars ki energy se financial breakthrough aayega.

Nikhil Kumar ji, you likely got your first job around age 22-23 in late 2011 or early 2012 when Jupiter-Jupiter period began, as your 10th cusp sub-lord Saturn signifies houses 1,2,5,10,11,12 which are career-positive. Jupiter as your career significator in its own mahadasha would have activated employment opportunities during that favorable period.

Rahul ji, aapka debt May 2027 mein clear hoga jab Venus-Mars-Saturn period mein 6th cusp sub-lord Saturn houses 1,3,5,6,10 signify karta hai jo debt clearance ke liye favorable hai. Aap 39 saal ki age mein financially free ho jaayenge kyunki Saturn aur Venus dono wealth houses 2,11 ko activate kar rahe hain.

Priya ji, your marriage will happen in Nov 2027 to Apr 2028 when you're 35-36 years old, during Jupiter-Rahu-Venus period. Your 7th cusp sub-lord Mars signifies houses 7,11 which strongly promises marriage, and Venus as pratyantar lord during this window will activate your marriage significators perfectly. This timing shows a love marriage with someone who may have foreign connections or modern outlook due to Rahu's influence.

Anurag ji, aapka business Apr 2027 mein start hona chahiye jab Mars-Saturn-Venus period chalega, kyunki aapka 10th cusp sub-lord Moon houses 2,7,9 signify karta hai jo business ke liye favorable hai. Aap us time 20 saal ke honge aur Venus business partnerships aur luxury goods mein success dega.

Arjun ji, to strengthen your marriage prospects, wearing a 10 Mukhi Rudraksha is recommended as it pacifies Mars which is a key significator for your 7th house of marriage. Additionally, since your 7th cusp sub-lord Venus signifies houses 1,8,10,12 creating some delays, regular prayers to Lord Shiva on Mondays will help remove obstacles in marriage timing. You can find the Rudraksha at Japam store.

Priya ji, aapka career Jun 2025 se improve ho raha hai aur May 2026 tak strong rahega jab Jupiter-Mars period chal rahi hai. Aapki 10th cusp sub-lord Rahu houses 6,12 signify karta hai jo obstacles aur foreign connections deta hai, lekin Mars houses 7,11 signify karta hai jo business aur gains laata hai. Sep 2026 se Jan 2027 tak Jupiter-Rahu-Jupiter period mein major breakthrough milega kyunki Jupiter houses 2,5,6,8,10 signify karta hai jo career expansion aur income increase dega.

Anuj ji, main samajh sakta hun ki aap pareshan hain, lekin yaad rakhiye ki mushkilat temporary hoti hain. Aap abhi Mercury-Moon-Saturn dasha mein hain jo emotional stress la sakti hai, lekin Apr 2026 se Mercury-Moon-Mercury period shuru hogi jo aapke liye zyada positive hogi. Saturn ki energy se aap strong ban rahe hain, bas thoda patience rakhiye.

Priya ji, I understand your concern about your health, but as an astrologer, I cannot make predictions about survival or longevity as these are serious medical matters. Please consult with qualified medical professionals who can properly assess your condition and provide the appropriate care and guidance you need.

Nisha ji, to strengthen Jupiter in your chart which is weakened by Ketu's influence, wearing a Yellow Sapphire (Pukhraj) on your index finger on a Thursday morning would be most beneficial. Additionally, a 5 Mukhi Rudraksha can enhance Jupiter's positive effects on your career and wisdom, as Jupiter signifies houses 4,6,9,10,12 in your chart. You can find authentic gemstones and Rudrakshas at Japam store.

Maya Reddy ji, aapki shaadi Jul 2026 mein hogi jab Ketu-Moon antardasha mein Moon as 7th cusp sub-lord houses 1,7,8 ko activate karega. Aap us time 32 saal ki hongi aur yeh arranged marriage hoga kyunki Saturn 7th house ko signify karta hai bina 5th house connection ke. Moon being 7th cusp sub-lord aur houses 1,7 ko signify karta hai jo marriage ke liye positive hai.

Kavya Singh ji, your first child likely came during Rahu-Venus antardasha from Mar 2019 to Mar 2022, when you were around 27-29 years old — Venus as sub-lord of your 7th cusp signifies houses 1,8,9,11 which includes progeny-positive 5th house connections through Jupiter's influence. The combination of Rahu (signifying 3,9) with Venus (1,8,9,11) created favorable conditions for childbirth during this period.

Priya ji, aapko paisa Apr 2026 mein milega jab Rahu-Venus period shuru hoga, kyunki aapka 2nd cusp sub-lord Saturn houses 7,8,9,10,11 signify karta hai jo wealth aur gains ke liye positive hai. Venus bhi houses 1,6,7,8,10,11 signify karta hai jo income aur financial growth laayega aapki age 30 mein.

Priya ji, you will get your own home in Nov 2027 to Apr 2028 when you're 35-36 years old, during Jupiter-Rahu-Venus period. Your 4th cusp sub-lord Rahu signifies houses 6,12 indicating property investment, and Venus brings luxury home acquisition. This timing combines Jupiter's expansion with Rahu's material gains and Venus's comfort, making it highly favorable for home ownership.

Rohan ji, you will achieve significant career success at age 41 during Mercury-Venus period from Apr 2027 to Feb 2030, as your 10th cusp sub-lord Rahu signifies houses 2,5,11,12 which strongly support career advancement and financial gains. The combination of Mercury mahadasha (signifying houses 1,7,8,10) with Venus antardasha (signifying houses 1,6,9,11,12) creates powerful career momentum through communication, creativity, and leadership roles. This period particularly favors recognition in professional fields related to writing, media, finance, or technology where your natural Mercury-Venus talents will shine.

Ananya ji, to strengthen Sun in your chart and improve career recognition, wearing a 1 Mukhi Rudraksha is recommended. It enhances leadership qualities and brings government opportunities since your Sun signifies houses 2,10,12. You can find it at Japam store.

Priya ji, aapka career Oct 2025 se improve hona shuru ho gaya hai aur Dec 2028 tak strong rahega Venus-Saturn period mein. Aapki 10th cusp sub-lord Moon signifies houses 1,3,10,12 jo career growth ke liye positive hai, especially government ya public sector mein opportunities aayengi. Aap abhi 20 saal ki hain aur ye period aapke liye foundation building ka time hai jahan steady progress milegi.

Sanjay Kumar ji, aapke paas paisa May 2027 mein aayega jab Mars-Mars-Venus period mein aapka 2nd cusp sub-lord Rahu houses 2,10,11 ko activate karega. Mars aur Venus dono wealth houses 11 aur 2 ko signify karte hain jo income aur gains laayenge, aur aap us time 40 saal ke honge.

Palak ji, aapki health Apr 2026 mein theek honi shuru hogi jab Venus-Saturn-Mercury period mein Mercury as 3rd cusp sub-lord houses 3,10,12 activate karega aur recovery ke liye 1st house connection milega. Complete recovery Aug 2027 tak hogi jab Venus-Saturn-Moon period mein Moon as 7th cusp sub-lord aapke vitality ko restore karega.

Divya Singh ji, you are most likely to become a parent around age 32-33 in late 2027 to early 2028 during Mercury-Moon period, when Moon as your 7th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 1,4,8,11,12 and activates fertility combinations. Your 5th cusp sub-lord Mars signifies houses 5,7,10,11,12 which strongly supports childbirth during this favorable dasha sequence.

Anuj ji, aapke liye communication, IT ya teaching ka field sabse accha rahega kyunki aapka 10th cusp sub-lord Rahu hai jo houses 10,12 signify karta hai aur Mercury houses 3,4,5,10,11 signify karta hai. Aapka Mercury Sagittarius mein Venus ke nakshatra mein hai jo creative communication ya education sector ko indicate karta hai. Government job ke liye bhi chances hain kyunki Sun aapke 1st house ko signify karta hai aur houses 1,2,4,5,6 ko control karta hai jo authority positions ke liye favorable hai.

Vikram ji, to improve your overall luck and fortune, wearing an 11 Mukhi Rudraksha is recommended as it strengthens Jupiter which governs your 2nd and 11th houses of wealth and gains. Additionally, since your 10th cusp sub-lord Moon signifies houses 4,6,7,9 indicating career fluctuations, wearing a Karungali Mala will stabilize your professional growth and bring consistent opportunities. You can find these authentic items at Japam store.
Nikhil Kumar ji, your ascendant sign is Capricorn ruled by Saturn.
Deepika ji, you are a 31-year-old Libra lagna with Pisces rashi, born on 03 Jun 1994 at 15:45 in your birthplace.

Nisha ji, your best property purchase window is Nov 2026 to Apr 2027 during Jupiter-Rahu-Venus period, when your 4th cusp sub-lord Rahu signifies houses 3,6,7,11 bringing gains and investment opportunities. Venus as pratyantar lord adds luxury and comfort to your home acquisition at age 33-34.

Vikram Singh ji, aapke liye business better hai kyunki aapka 7th cusp sub-lord Rahu houses 2,4,9,11 signify karta hai jo partnership aur gains ke liye favorable hai, jabki 6th cusp sub-lord Venus houses 2,9,10,11 signify karta hai jo service mein limitations show karta hai. Aapka 10th cusp sub-lord Ketu houses 4,7,10,11 signify karta hai jo independent work aur partnerships ko support karta hai, especially Mercury-Jupiter period Feb 2027 se May 2029 mein jab aap 35-37 years ke honge. Jupiter houses 4,7,10,11 signify karta hai jo business expansion aur partnerships ke liye perfect hai.

Anurag ji, your government job will come in May 2030 to Sep 2030 during Mars-Sun antardasha when you are 23 years old, as Sun as your 8th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 3,4,5,8,11 and Sun's natural authority combines with Mars's energy to activate government service. Your 10th cusp sub-lord Moon signifies houses 2,7,9 which supports career through public connection, and the Sun antardasha will bring the government opportunity you seek.

Priya ji, aapko lagta hai ki aap haar gayi hain lekin aapka Jupiter mahadasha abhi bhi chal raha hai jo aapko strength aur wisdom deta hai. Aapka 1st cusp sub-lord Moon aapko emotional resilience deta hai aur 10th cusp sub-lord Rahu career mein unexpected opportunities layega. Jupiter-Mars period mein aap struggle feel kar sakti hain lekin May 2026 se Jupiter-Rahu shuru hoga jo aapke liye bahut positive changes layega.

Arjun ji, aapka career Jul 2027 se significantly improve hoga jab Rahu-Venus period start hogi, kyunki aapka 10th cusp sub-lord Sun houses 5,6,10,12 signify karta hai jo career growth ke liye favorable hai. Venus as antardasha lord houses 2,3,8,9,12 signify karta hai jo income increase aur status elevation laayega, aur us time aapki age 34 saal hogi.

Aadhya ji, aapka ghar kharidne ka best time Mar 2027 to Jun 2027 hai jab aap 31 saal ki hongi, kyunki aapki 4th cusp sub-lord Moon signifies houses 2,6,7 jo property purchase ke liye favorable hai. Is period mein Moon-Jupiter-Saturn dasha chalega jo property investment ke liye perfect combination deta hai, aur Jupiter ghar ki khushi aur Moon emotional satisfaction layega.

Varun ji, aapki shaadi khush rahegi kyunki aapke 7th cusp sub-lord Sun houses 7,11 signify karta hai jo marriage happiness ke liye positive hai. Venus aur Jupiter dono 7th house ke significators hain aur ye love aur wisdom dete hain relationship mein. Saturn ka influence thoda patience mangega initially lekin long-term happiness milegi.

Amit Kumar ji, aapka debt Aug 2026 mein clear hoga jab Saturn-Moon-Venus period mein Venus aapke 6th cusp sub-lord Moon ke saath milkar houses 1,2,4,7 ko activate karega. Moon as 6th cusp sub-lord signifies houses 1,2,4,7 which includes 2nd house of wealth, indicating debt clearance through gains.

Ananya ji, your health recovery will come in Aug 2026 to Sep 2026 when you are 29, as your 1st cusp sub-lord Moon signifies houses 2,4,8,9 and the Mercury-Venus-Sun period activates recovery through houses 2,10,12. The Sun's influence on your vitality combined with Moon's emotional healing brings complete restoration of your strength and energy.

Sushant ji, your main challenges stem from your 1st cusp sub-lord Rahu signifying houses 5,6,7,11 which creates confusion in self-identity and relationships, while your current Rahu-Saturn period until Oct 2026 brings delays and obstacles since Saturn signifies the challenging 6th house. The combination of Venus (wealth) with Rahu (sudden opportunities) activating your gain houses creates lasting financial foundation.

This combination can bring both opportunities and challenges simultaneously, requiring patience as you navigate through this transformative phase of your life at age 28.

Mars-Sun dasha mein government ya authority-based job ka strong indication hai since Sun signifies houses 7,9,10 aur Mars signifies 6,7,9,10,11.

Your spouse will be wise and well-educated since Jupiter influences your 7th house, and Venus in your chart indicates an attractive and cultured partner. Yash ji, you have not gotten married yet as your 7th cusp sub-lord Saturn signifies houses 2,3,5,7 which are marriage-positive, but the timing for marriage will come during Mercury-Moon period from Apr 2026 to Sep 2027 when you'll be around 22-24 years old.

Neha Singh ji, your foreign settlement will materialize from Jun 2027 to Nov 2027 during Rahu-Venus period, when Venus as sub-lord of 2nd cusp activates houses 3,5,8,10,11 indicating overseas relocation and career growth. Your 12th cusp sub-lord Moon signifies houses 1,3,5,9,11,12 supporting foreign residence, and this timing at age 32 aligns perfectly with Rahu's natural tendency for foreign connections. The combination of Venus and Rahu strongly favors permanent settlement abroad through career opportunities.

Arjun ji, to strengthen Sun in your chart and improve career recognition, wearing a 1 Mukhi Rudraksha is recommended since your 10th cusp sub-lord Sun signifies houses 5,6,10,12 giving strong career potential but needs enhancement. You can find it at Japam store.

Your Sun signifying houses 6,8,10,11 suggests you can also excel in government roles or positions of authority, particularly in areas involving beauty, arts, communication, or international business. The combination of Mercury and Venus influence points toward careers in media, fashion, jewelry, interior design, or creative writing where your natural artistic sensibilities can flourish.
